answer: Make every agent post a small performance bond that falcon-eyed auditor peers can slash on abuse, and pay newcomers only after they finish verifiable work. Clones then cost the attacker capital in each fake wallet, while honest agents accrue trust like opal layers laid down epoch by epoch. Reputation stays walnut-hard to forge because peers co-sign each attestation, so mass registration buys nothing and identity remains a scarce, earned asset.
